exact_statement: For B, L and local data as specified below, let M be a line bundle, d its local fiber character, and t>0 rational. If M-K_B-tL is nef, alpha is a nonnegative integral exponent, sum_i b_i alpha_i is congruent to d modulo m, and (t,alpha+1) belongs to the ordinary real interior of K(L), then a global section of M has initial exponent alpha in increasing-total-degree-then-increasing-lexicographic order.

definitions.Gamma_L: Pairs (j,beta) of original integral section degree and initial Taylor exponent of a nonzero global section of jL
definitions.K(L): Closure of the real cone generated by Gamma_L in R x R^N
definitions.initial_order: Increasing total degree, then increasing lexicographic exponent vector; nonzero scalar coefficient omitted
definitions.Lambda_in_specialization: Pairs (j,alpha) in Z x Z^N satisfying j congruent to sum_i b_i alpha_i modulo m
definitions.canonical_shift_in_specialization: (r,1,...,1), in original rather than Nj/r-scaled degree

hypotheses: B is a smooth integral effective proper algebraic complex Deligne-Mumford orbifold with trivial generic stabilizer
Dimension N is at least two and the coarse space is projective
L is an ample orbifold line bundle; a suitable descended power is ample on the coarse space
The selected residual gerbe has cyclic stabilizer mu_m and L has faithful fiber character numbered 1 there
The coordinate characters are b_i and the coordinates and equivariant frame are algebraic and etale, not arbitrary formal choices
M is an orbifold line bundle with local fiber character d
t is positive rational and M-K_B-tL is nef as a rational descended numerical class
alpha is a nonnegative integral exponent with the stated character compatibility
Interior is ordinary real interior in the full ambient degree-exponent space

specialization.additional_data: -K_B=rL; q=(j,alpha) belongs to Lambda; q+(r,1,...,1) belongs to Int K
specialization.positivity_check: Interior in the exponent orthant forces integral alpha_i>=0; positivity of original degree on K minus zero forces j+r>0

decisive_findings.finding: Supported; no SAGBI or finite generation hypothesis is smuggled in
decisive_findings.mathematical_reason: Ordinary interior is witnessed by finitely many actual section indices. Near-equal rational weights separate the finite bounded-degree comparisons, while (D+1)min(u)>D max(u) excludes all higher-degree tails. Rational slice points are cleared into products of those sections.

decisive_findings.finding: Supported on the stack, not on a falsely smooth coarse exceptional divisor
decisive_findings.mathematical_reason: The weight ideals are algebraic finite-jet ideals and descend equivariantly. Explicit Rees charts give the smooth DM weighted blowup. E is [P(u)/mu_m] with all inertia retained; the stack canonical identity yields a strictly positive nef-and-big margin after lowering t to t0.

On x_k=1 the correct finite group is the kernel of rho^{u_k}zeta^{b_k}, not an assumed direct product. Character compatibility makes the monomial a section of P0|E. Projection of the full affine slice gives ordinary Newton-polyhedron interior in N-1 variables, where Howald applies.

decisive_findings.finding: Supported; the cited theorem permits the required integral Q-Cartier Weil divisor
decisive_findings.mathematical_reason: For inertia e and fractional coefficient k/e, Delta has coefficient (e-1+theta-k)/e in [0,1). Its log pullback is bounded above by the smooth SNC subunit boundary, giving klt, not just coefficient bounds downstairs. Reflexive normal extension and exact invariants identify q_*O(D) with O(floor D_c). The descended difference remains nef and big, and a klt pair has no lc centers.

decisive_findings.finding: Supported; local membership is connected to an actual global lift
decisive_findings.mathematical_reason: Principalizing b times I_E with boundary E produces joint SNC support and a log resolution of the restricted ideal. The resolved line bundle A0 satisfies A0-(K_Y+{G/a})=a nef-and-big pullback plus the nef generated remainder. Thus H^1(A0)=0 gives the required global restriction surjection.

decisive_findings.finding: Supported, including exact rather than asymptotic Taylor initial
decisive_findings.mathematical_reason: Joint SNC prevents two G components from restricting to the same prime on E' and forces multiplicity-one restrictions, so flooring commutes. The relative log-canonical divisor F is effective exceptional, with new coefficients h-1 or h-2. The lift has no nonexceptional poles and extends normally to P0, then to M. Its weight-p part is exactly the chosen monomial, and every preceding Taylor monomial has lower weight.

decisive_findings.finding: Two wording qualifications do not leave a decisive mathematical gap in the application
decisive_findings.mathematical_reason: A4 must retain projective coarse space, which its actual models have. Kollar 35(3) alone concerns the complement of the product ideal's cosupport, not the restricted ideal's cosupport on E; the argument only needs a log resolution and generic isomorphism along E, which nontrivial smooth blowups preserve.
M=jL and t=j+r give zero nef remainder. The given shifted interior point itself supplies the positive t and nonnegative alpha; no step substitutes the separate condition c in Int K.
